_: Drill's default configuration. Committed, so keep it free of secrets.
To set your own: copy this file to config.local.json and edit that.
config.local.json is gitignored and overrides anything here.
config.local.json is fetched at runtime, not bundled, so Drill must be
served over http — npm run dev, or any static server over dist/. Opening
index.html as a file:// page cannot read it.
Every field below can also be set in the app under Menu -> Settings, and
what you set there wins over what is written here.

decks._: defaultPath is where the Example decks browser looks. autoSync only means Drill checks that folder on startup when it is served over http; there is no cloud sync and nothing leaves your machine.

ui._: Starting values for a fresh install. Changing them later has no effect once your browser has a database; use Settings instead.

fsrs._: weights: null uses the pinned FSRS-6 defaults. Supply an array of exactly 21 numbers to use your own optimised set; anything else falls back to the defaults.
